response.sql: WITH station_weather_groups AS (SELECT t."observstation", o."weathprofile", AVG(t."bandusagepct") AS avg_bandwidth_usage, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM "telescopes" AS t INNER JOIN "observatories" AS o ON t."observstation" = o."observstation" WHERE t."pointaccarc" > 4.86 GROUP BY t."observstation", o."weathprofile") SELECT AVG(avg_bandwidth_usage) AS average_group_bandwidth_usage, AVG(telescope_count) AS average_group_telescope_count FROM station_weather_groups;
